summary: Ignore lastIndex as the search start for RegExp without global or sticky flags and leave it unchanged.

target.notes: RegExpBuiltinExec reads/ToLength-coerces lastIndex but then sets its internal search start to 0 when neither g nor y is set; it does not write the property on success/failure.

caveats: Although the search start is forced to zero, ToLength conversion of an arbitrary assigned lastIndex value can run user conversion hooks or throw.

tests.name: positive lastIndex ignored
tests.input: const r=/a/; r.lastIndex=99; const m=r.exec('a'); console.log(m.index,r.lastIndex);
